text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's my day off, and I've decided to come
and watch an Umamusume pro wrestling
trial lesson
that I saw advertised on a
poster...

text_block_list.name: Masked Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Okay. That's enough warming up.
Next, we'll be moving on to regular
strength training. Ahem...
So, are you lot
ready to get ripped?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
HELL YES! It's time to unleash our
potencia total!
Isn't that right, Dober?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well... firstly, I'm not used to all this
yelling... And
more importantly, how did
I even end up here?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hey! I seem to remember you asking me
for a fun
way to spend your free time! So
I simply brought
you somewhere fun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well, yes, I suppose I did ask... Still, I
have to say, Umamusume wrestlers sure
are physically huge,
aren't they? They're
a little intimidating.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: No way, no way. Wrestlers do have bulky bods, but they also have muy bulky hearts! So you don't need to be afraid!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
C'mon! Let's do it together! Uno! Dos!
Tres!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: F... Five! Six! Seven!

text_block_list.name: Masked Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes, good effort! Can you keep going? For
wrestlers, squats are the most
important exercise!
If you hang in there,
then soon...

text_block_list.name: Masked Umamusume
text_block_list.text: You'll be able to do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The wrestler throws herself into the ring
and
immediately performs a magnificent
special
move, midair!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! W-wow!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A finishing hold! Such a daring and
climático
move! What do you think,
Dober? Isn't wrestling
amazing?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah... It's actually pretty entertaining.

text_block_list.name: Masked Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Time for today's main event! It's
time to practice entering the ring with
style! Who thinks
they can flaunt it like a
real wrestler?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wow... Playing to the crowd like a real
wrestler...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Here, here! How can we say no to that?!
We'll be
the first to show our stuff!

text_block_list.name: Masked Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Stepping into the ring right now, it's the

undefeated lucha libre champion, El!
The!
Greeeat!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: BRING IT OOOON!

text_block_list.name: Masked Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Next up! The ultimate weapon, born into
a long
lineage of elite wrestlers—iiit's
the Mighty Dober!
...Hm?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Dober, estás bien?! We're supposed to
be
entering the ring together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I... I can't do it! Going in while
everyone's
watching... There's just no
way!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Look... my heart's just not as strong as
yours.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha! You overestimate me! I'm not
that
strong myself!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But this mask I wear gives me courage
whenever I
need it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So, right now... I will share part of that
courage
with you!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hola, everyone! We are the ones you've
been waitin' for! The mighty tag team
that needs no
introduction! Condorrr
aaand Doberrr!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I am the phantom bird of the ring, El the
Great!
I'll swoop in and steal your heart
from above!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now the attention's on me! All you have
to do... is
climb into the ring and boldly
declare your
nombre!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Th-the... Mighty D-Dober!

text_block_list.name: Event Participants
text_block_list.text:
Wooo! El! Dober!
El! Doberrr!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I ended up in the spotlight anyway,
but I guess it was pretty fun once I gave
it a try. I owe it to
you for taking the
lead, El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... You can thank my mask for that,
too! As long as I have this mask, I can
become the
greatest entertainer in the
world, anytime!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All I did was share a minúscula portion of
my
abundant courage! The rest was all
you, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I guess that means you are to me
what that
mask is to you.
